messages:
Asha (Partnerships): Quick sync — CloudCorp + TitanHW want a co-sell private offer for Q3. Need to lock pricing window, how credits count against commit, and renewal mechanics.
Liam (Sales): Nice. Do we want the marketplace private offer to include HW credits or have those as a separate rebate?
Ravi (Finance): Important: only spend we can invoice or reserve counts toward committed consumption. One-off activation credits shouldn't depress committed thresholds.
Mariana (Legal): Also need unified language for transferability of credits and whether credits survive renewal. I can draft a clause but want agreement on policy first.
Nora (Solutions): From SI perspective, bundling HW credits into the private offer simplifies quoting for partners. SI teams prefer single SKU.
Asha (Partnerships): Proposal: two-track offer 
- Track A: 12mo committed spend on marketplace (discount SKU) + TitanHW $X install credit applied as separate SKU redemption at onboarding.
- Track B: No-commit marketplace listing with time-limited onboarding credits and SI co-sell referral credit.
Liam (Sales): I like tracks. For Track A we should include a ramp schedule (quarterly commit targets) so renewal conversations have clear gates.
Ravi (Finance): Ramp schedule ok. Need to avoid double-counting: credit redemptions must be recorded as contra-revenue, not reduction of recognized committed ARR.
Mariana (Legal): Draft clause: `credits are promotional, non-transferable unless explicitly stated, expire 180 days, and do not modify invoiced committed obligations.` Any objections?
Liam (Sales): :thumbsup: No objections. Can we allow conversion of unused onboarding credits into a renewal discount (one-time apply) to make renewals stickier?
Ravi (Finance): We can allow conversion but cap at 25% of first-year renewal discount and only if customer meets baseline usage. Need clear accounting flow.
Nora (Solutions): Operational ask: marketplace private offer SKU mapping needs to show both Redwood SKU and TitanHW credit SKU. Example snippet for marketplace team: 
```
{ "offer_name": "CloudCorp Co-Sell - Track A", "items": ["redwood-reserved-capacity-v2", "titanhw-install-credit-5000"], "commit_term_months": 12 }
```
Asha (Partnerships): Good example. marketplace-bot — does the marketplace allow multiple SKUs in a single private offer for co-sell bundles?
marketplace-bot: CloudMarketplace supports multi-line private offers but partner-managed credits must be redeemed outside the marketplace flow unless the partner uploads them as marketplace-entitled SKUs. Check vendor onboarding docs.
Mariana (Legal): So we need partner-signed MOU that clarifies credit redemption flow and liability. I'll draft and circulate by EOD Fri.
Liam (Sales): For renewals: recommend a 90-day pre-expiry notification + 30-day window for private-offer acceptance on the marketplace. If acceptance not received, auto-fallback to public list price with standard uplift.
Ravi (Finance): Agree on 90/30 cadence. Also need telemetry event to flag offers approaching non-acceptance so AMs can intervene.
Nora (Solutions): I'll add a runbook for AMs and SI to follow when an offer hits the 60/30/7 day alerts.
Asha (Partnerships): Action items: 
- Asha: Draft partner-facing offer sheet for Tracks A/B and distribute to TitanHW + CloudCorp by Tue.
- Ravi: Confirm accounting treatment for credit conversions and cap by Wed.
- Mariana: Draft MOU language + credit clause by EOD Fri.
- Nora: Create AM/SI runbook for renewal cadence and SKU mapping by next Mon.
Liam: I'll sync with the marketplace listing team for acceptance windows and parity checks.
Mariana (Legal): One quick flag — if TitanHW insists on co-marketing commitments in the MOU, we must spell out announcement timing and approval cycles to avoid surprise joint announcements.
Asha (Partnerships): Good call. We'll add a joint announcement timeline with 10 business day approvals from both sides.
Liam (Sales): :rocket: Let's pilot this with one GA account first. Thanks all.
Ravi (Finance): noted.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: private offers expire automatically if not accepted by `expiration_date` on the offer. Ensure AMs track acceptance.
Asha (Partnerships): I'll post the draft offer sheet here when ready. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
